pr_title: Bluetooth: Mesh: Add cfg cli list getters
pr_body:
Adds config client getters for all list commands:
- mod_app_get
- mod_sub_get
- net_key_get
- app_key_get

Closes #24505.

Signed-off-by: Trond Einar Snekvik <Trond.Einar.Snekvik@nordicsemi.no>

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Mesh: Configuration Client: Add support for Model Subscription Get
issue_context.body:
**Problem**
Nodes implemented with the Configuration Client model needs to be able to send a "Config SIG Model Subscription Get" message or "Config Vendor Model Subscription Get". On the target node, the configuration server model shall reply with a "Config SIG Model Subscription List" or "Config Vendor Model Subscription List" containing all addresses from the Subscription List of the model. The Bluetooth mesh APIs does not have a function for this. 

**Possible solution**
Bluetooth mesh configuration client model:
-Add function that gets the Subscription List from target node. 
-Add model opcode handler for ("Config SIG Model Subscription List", 0x80 0x2A)
-Add model opcode handler for ("Config Vendor Model Subscription List", 0x80 0x2C)

Bluetooth mesh configuration server model:
-Add model opcode handler for("Config SIG Model Subscription Get, 0x80 0x29)
-Add model opcode handler for("Config Vendor Model Subscription Get, 0x80 0x2B)
